newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian chocolate maker Kras close to EBRD deal.
newsitem.headline: Croatian chocolate maker Kras close to EBRD deal.

text.p: Croatian chocolate maker Kras said on Thursday it was soon to close an agreement on investment with the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD).
"We are now in the final stage of negotiations, but there are still some technical and other details to be settled," finance director Tomislav Jovic told Reuters by telephone.
He declined to give details of the proposed deal or time frame but said it was "imminent". Jovic heads the company's negotiating team.
"Kras has a well-defined development strategy and both sides have found their interests in that. These have now been defined. We are very close to signing," he said.
There was no comment available from the bank at this stage.
But rumours about its plans to invest in Kras and spur its privatisation have moved the chocolate maker's stock up again over the past week after a long stagnation.
Kras closed 10 kuna higher at 490 kuna Wednesday and was among the most actively traded issues on Zagreb's bourse.
